note: Machine-readable launch status. G8 (governance) moved UNRESOLVED->PASS via explicit human confirmation (Naoto Fujie, spec/human-decisions.md). G13 (release artifacts) moved CONDITIONAL_PASS->PASS via explicit steward acceptance of the TII 1.0 Production Candidate bundle. G7 (resolver) moved CONDITIONAL_PASS->PASS after independent verification (Vercel CLI + live RDAP) of a domain purchase the operator completed themselves, after Vercel's own CLI refused to execute it non-interactively. G3 (key custody) moved CONDITIONAL_PASS->PASS on 2026-09-13: after the FileVault-vs-encryption correction (see history below), a second candidate key (46b11023f849e931) was generated correctly but retired for an insufficient 9-byte passphrase, and a final key (1486de6152baec7f, Ed25519, passphrase-encrypted PKCS8, strong passphrase from first creation) was generated by the human operator in their own terminal and independently verified by the agent at every step -- public-key checksum, key ID derivation, operational-file checksum, USB recovery-copy byte-identity, and a recovery rehearsal were all re-derived by the agent directly from the files, never merely taken from the human's report. No gate was marked PASS merely because more documentation exists, a report was trusted without independent verification, or a security boundary was worked around. See spec/production-launch-gate.md, spec/resolver-domain-decision.md sections 15-18, spec/production-key-custody.md sections 8.5-8.7, and spec/human-decisions.md for the full decision trail.
